description: On desktop, the app's own page may ask whether the removal of Halonic's WSL setup is offered, show the save dialog for the backup file of that removal (wsl_backup_choose) and show the file it saved in the file manager (wsl_backup_reveal), through src/sandbox_backup.rs. The shell shows the dialog itself and reveals only the file the person chose there, never a path the page names. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets none of it.
